title: Fictitiousness of Einstein's Field Equations
content: Einstein’s field equations are considered one of the greatest intellectual achievements of physics. Their weak point is that they do not have a physical meaning. Einstein's field equations are figurative mathematics meant to describe the gravitational force and cannot be used to calculate it, for example, between the Moon and the Earth. The curvature of space is a mathematical formulation of gravity that should be replaced by the energy density of space.
